Anhao1314/Go2w-MoRA-navigation.body:
# MoRA-Train: A Hierarchical Training System for Embodied Agents

### First adapter: Unitree Go2W wheeled-legged quadruped long-horizon navigation

*MoRA-Train: A Hierarchical Training System for Embodied Agents · First adapter: Unitree Go2W*

- **Document type:** Systems engineering and research notes (not a peer-reviewed paper)
- **Project body:** MoRA-Train (MoRA-inspired hierarchical training system for embodied agents)
- **Role of this repository:** First Task Adapter / testbed + S0 C++ control core
- **Training side:** Windows (all Go2W training and evaluation)
- **Quantitative analysis side:** RL-Sentinel (Mac, time-correct analysis of training reliability)
- **Scope:** Simulation only; not for real robot deployment; does not claim to reproduce the official MoRA

[English](https://github.com/Anhao1314/Go2w-MoRA-navigation/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · [Architecture and Interfaces](https://github.com/Anhao1314/Go2w-MoRA-navigation/blob/HEAD/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [Experiment Report Index](https://github.com/Anhao1314/Go2w-MoRA-navigation/blob/HEAD/docs/EXPERIMENTS.md) · [Reproduction Guide](https://github.com/Anhao1314/Go2w-MoRA-navigation/blob/HEAD/docs/USAGE.md) · [Integrity Upgrade Notes](https://github.com/Anhao1314/Go2w-MoRA-navigation/blob/HEAD/docs/INTEGRITY_UPGRADE.md)

## 0. Project Positioning

MoRA-Train is not about “getting a robot dog to walk one path,” but about:

> How to train an embodied agent composed of S2 planning, S1 goal-conditioned execution (multi-granularity memory + progress closed loop), and S0 verifiable control, and to train, evaluate, and quantify it across multiple tasks rather than tuning it for a single platform.

Go2W is MoRA-Train's **first task adapter and testbed**, used to verify:

- Whether the hierarchical interfaces are composable: S2 rule-based decisions → S1 learned policy → S0 C++ control;
- Whether S0 is numerically trustworthy: FK/IK/Jacobian, center-of-mass dynamics, and MPC consistent with MuJoCo;
- Whether S1 can complete multi-segment, branching, waypoint, and other long-horizon tasks;
- Whether the training process can be analyzed by RL-Sentinel…

Dice!Next is a self-hosted dice bot for TRPG tabletop games. Connect your bot account to roll dice in chat, manage character sheets, and record sessions. Configure and maintain it through the web panel.

Currently in Beta, with packages for Windows, Linux, and macOS, plus a [Docker deployment option](https://github.com/DiceZone/Dice-Next-Docker).

## Quick Start

1. Download the package for your operating system and architecture from the **Assets** section of [Releases](https://github.com/DiceZone/Dice-Next/releases). Do not choose `Source code`. Extract the archive completely into a fixed directory. Do not run it from inside the archive or from the system temp directory.
2. Start it as shown in the table below. The release package already includes the WebUI, so there is no need to build the frontend separately.

   | OS | Architecture / package format | How to start |
   | --- | --- | --- |
   | Windows | x64 (amd64) / ARM64 · `.zip` | Double-click `dice-next.exe` |
   | Linux | x64 (amd64) / ARM64 · `.tar.gz` | Run `./start.sh` in the extracted directory |
   | macOS | Apple Silicon (arm64) · `.tar.gz` | Run `./start.sh` in the extracted directory |

3. Open [http://localhost:18088](http://localhost:18088) and follow the guide to set an admin password. On Windows, the app runs in the system tray by default. You can also right-click the tray icon and choose "Open Web Panel". If the port is already in use, it automatically switches to an available port.
4. Add a connection under "Adapter Management". After the connection succeeds, send commands:

   ```text
   .help
   .r 3d6+2
   .r 2#d100
   ```

Not connected to a chat platform yet? You can try commands first using the "Test Bench" in the panel. For startup or connection problems, see the [Installation Guide](https://docs.dice.zone/guide/install.html) and [Troubleshooting](https://docs.dice.zone/guide/troubleshooting.html).

Fishsb/dsh-prompt-enhancer.body:
# dsh-prompt-enhancer

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: **Prompt optimization** + **Voice input enhancement**. It rewrites drafts in the input box to be clearer and more actionable, and adds hotkeys, auto-stop on silence, filler-word removal, and corrections to voice input.

Drafts often contain only half a request, and sending them to the model then requires back-and-forth clarification. Click ✨ to rewrite in place; if you're not satisfied, you can undo. For voice, just speak: a pause stops recording, and the result goes back into the input box.

## Installation

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Fishsb/dsh-prompt-enhancer#v3.4.2
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-prompt-enhancer   # Update
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-prompt-enhancer   # Uninstall
```

After installing (or after updating or uninstalling), restart DSH. If ✨ appears in the input toolbar, the installation succeeded. You need [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **≥ 0.1.0-rc.6** installed locally, and `pnpm` must be on the PATH.

## What it can do

**Prompt optimization**

- ✨ **One-click optimization**: rewrites the current draft. You can keep optimizing, undo, or cancel while optimization is running.
- **5 modes**: Basic / Light / Standard / Expert / One-click publish
- **Memory toggle**: multi-round optimizations before sending accumulate into a memory chain, which is cleared on send (off by default)
- **Model chain**: multiple models are tried in order. You can add, remove, reorder, toggle thinking, and test connectivity inline.

**Voice input enhancement** (recognition is provided by DSH's official `speechToText`; the plugin does not include its own recognition engine and does not download models)

- **Two entry points**: the official 🎤 button, or the plugin hotkey (tap to start, tap again to stop; long press = hold to talk, release to stop)
- **Silence detection**: automatically stops when speech ends. The silence threshold is adjustable from 1 to 5 seconds (default 2 seconds), and the feature can be turned off entirely.
- **Filler-word removal**: local rules remove filler words, repetitions, and drawn-out sounds. It does not rewrite or add content (on by default).
- **Voice correction**: performs word-level corrections after recognition. It applies only to the voice path (off by default).
- **Auto-enhance**: automatically triggers enhancement after recognized text fills the draft (off by default)

Buttons and text follow the DSH interface language (Chinese / English).

## Settings quick reference

Settings → "提示词增强" (Prompt Enhancement). Changes are saved immediately.

| Location | Content |
|---|---|
| Model configuration | Model chain; speech recognition: hotkey, silence detection (1–5 seconds), filler-word removal, voice correction, auto-enhance |
| Optimization parameters | Optimization mode, templates, memory toggle, context budget, timeout / reply length / output limit |

Recording capture, recognition, and write-back are all handled by DSH…

Leosu16/enableMacSiriAI.description: Manages and locks the country-code cache for non-mainland-China-market Apple Silicon Macs used in mainland China, without disabling SIP, helps enable Siri AI, and restores regional availability of overseas Maps and News.
Leosu16/enableMacSiriAI.body:
# enableMacSiriAI

`enableMacSiriAI` is intended for users in mainland China who use non-China-market Apple Silicon Macs. It can read, modify, lock, and restore the macOS country code cache without disabling SIP and without installing kernel extensions. After setting the country code to a supported overseas region, it can also restore regional availability of overseas Apple Maps and Apple News.

[English README](https://github.com/Leosu16/enableMacSiriAI/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)

> [!WARNING]
> This is an unofficial experimental tool. Modifying the country code cache may affect Maps, location services, content availability, and other regional features, and it cannot guarantee that Apple Intelligence or Siri AI will be available.

## Requirements

- macOS 27
- Apple Silicon Mac
- A device sold outside mainland China
- An administrator account

This tool does not support China-market Macs. When it encounters an unsupported device or an unrecognized cache format, it refuses to make changes.

## Quick Start

Download the project, open Terminal in the project directory, then run:

```bash
chmod +x enableMacSiriAI
./enableMacSiriAI
```

Select a country or action in the menu:

- `1` — United States (`US`)
- `2` — Canada (`CA`)
- `3` — United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, or Singapore
- `4` — Only remove the current cache lock, without modifying contents
- `5` — Restore the original cache
- `6` — Refresh the status display
- `7` — Run a read-only Siri AI diagnostic
- `0` — Exit

Changing or restoring the cache requires entering the Mac administrator password. The password is entered only at the macOS `sudo` prompt, and this tool does not store it.

After setting the country code, restart your Mac. After restarting, run `enableMacSiriAI` again to confirm that the country code and lock status are correct.

## Restoring the Original Cache

Open the menu, choose `5`, then enter `RESTORE` or `restore` as prompted. After a successful restore, you can choose to keep or delete the backup.

You can also run it directly:

```bash
sudo ./enableMacSiriAI restore                    # Restore and keep the backup
sudo ./enableMacSiriAI restore --delete-backup    # Delete the backup after a successful restore
```

The tool automatically saves the original cache so it can be restored. Restart your Mac after the restore completes.

## Other Commands

```bash
./enableMacSiriAI status
./enableMacSiriAI diagnose
sudo ./enableMacSiriAI set US
sudo…
```

Yuremado (揺れ窓) is a PWA app that displays Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) earthquake information, earthquake early warnings, tsunami information, and real-time seismic intensity on a map.

It is based on [kotoho7/scratch-realtime-earthquake-viewer-page](https://github.com/kotoho7/scratch-realtime-earthquake-viewer-page).

TencentBlueKing/blueking-apigateway.body:
---

Simplified Chinese | [English](https://github.com/TencentBlueKing/blueking-apigateway/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)

## Overview

BlueKing API Gateway (API Gateway) is a high-performance, highly available API hosting service that helps developers create, publish, maintain, monitor, and protect APIs, so that data or services from BlueKing applications or other systems can be opened to external users quickly, at low cost, and with low risk.

BlueKing API Gateway is divided into a control plane and a data plane. The control plane handles API configuration, publishing, monitoring, permission management, and similar functions. The data plane handles API traffic forwarding, security protection, and similar functions. The data plane is built on [Apache APISIX](https://github.com/apache/apisix) with a series of added plugins to support BlueKing API Gateway's features. Thanks to the dynamic, real-time, and high-performance characteristics of Apache APISIX, BlueKing API Gateway can support high-concurrency, low-latency API hosting services.

This project is `BlueKing API Gateway - Control Plane`.

**Core open-source service projects of BlueKing API Gateway**

- BlueKing API Gateway - [Control Plane](https://github.com/TencentBlueKing/blueking-apigateway)
  - dashboard: the control plane of API Gateway
  - dashboard-front: the frontend of the API Gateway control plane
  - operator: gateway configuration conversion
  - core-api: the high-performance core API of the gateway
  - mcp-proxy: MCP server proxy for the gateway
  - esb: ESB component service
- BlueKing API Gateway - [Data Plane](https://github.com/TencentBlueKing/blueking-apigateway-apisix)

## Features

- API lifecycle management: covers the management of each stage of an API, including configuration, publishing, testing, monitoring, and retirement.
- Version release: supports multi-environment management. Users can create new environments to meet needs such as development, testing, and production. Provides API version management, where each environment can switch versions with one click without affecting the others.
- Documentation and SDKs: provides online documentation and SDKs for calling gateway APIs, lowering the barrier to using APIs.
- Permission management: permission restrictions are enabled by default, with support for permission expiration and authorization dimensions.
- Security protection: supports BlueKing application authentication and user authentication to control request sources; supports IP access control with configurable IP blacklists and whitelists; supports second-level traffic control, allowing traffic allocation as needed to prevent backend service overload caused by high traffic; supports operation auditing.
- Observability: supports request log queries; supports integration with OpenTelemetry; includes a variety of built-in alert policies.

# Daily Agent Benchmarks

**Live site: https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/** · [Archive](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/archive.html) · [Atom feed](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/feed.xml)

A daily, searchable list of new **AI / LLM agent benchmarks** on arXiv — web agents, GUI & computer-use agents, coding / SWE agents, tool use, multi-agent, embodied, and agent safety evaluations. Each paper gets a page with authors, abstract, field, citation count, and arXiv PDF / HTML links. Updated automatically every day via GitHub Actions.

Collects **Agent Benchmark** papers from [arXiv](https://arxiv.org) daily and organizes them into a static site deployable to GitHub Pages.

The site lists entries in reverse order of submission date: title, authors, abstract, category, and PDF / HTML links. Each day has a bilingual Chinese–English digest. In-browser ranked search uses **BM25**.

## What this repository does

1. **Runs once a day** (GitHub Actions, or manually run locally) and calls the arXiv API.
2. **Keeps only Agent Benchmark papers**: first retrieves candidates with agent + benchmark related queries, then filters them by keyword scoring (LLM agent, web/GUI/coding agent, tool-use, computer-use, etc.). Generic RL agents, reagents / pathogens, and other unrelated usages are excluded.
3. **Merges into the index** `docs/data/index.json`, grouped by `published` date.
4. **Generates the daily digest** (no paid model required): topic statistics plus the first sentence of the abstract of high-scoring papers, one in Chinese and one in English.
5. **GitHub Pages** reads this JSON to render the page. Search runs in the browser and does not depend on a backend.

# IEXA-WIN

> IEXA-WIN is the **Windows desktop version** of the [IEXA](https://IEXA.app) iOS / Android app, bringing mainstream AI models into a native desktop experience, with support for a real shell, filesystem access, web page fetching, cross-session memory, and multi-device sync.

---

## 2026-09-13 Security and Runtime Update

Details of this fix are in the [remediation delivery record](https://github.com/bidalu9-crypto/IEXA-windowns-/blob/HEAD/docs/REMEDIATION_2026-09-13.md), and build details are in the [reproducible build notes](https://github.com/bidalu9-crypto/IEXA-windowns-/blob/HEAD/docs/RENDERER_BUILD_REPRODUCIBILITY.md).

- `start.bat` / `npm start` only listen on the loopback address and open the workbench directly, no longer requiring a one-time login code. Electron still automatically establishes an HttpOnly session, while programmatic APIs and test servers still use explicit Bearer/Cookie identity.
- By default, HTTP only listens on the loopback address. The phone bridge enables HTTPS separately. On first connection, either trust the `iexa-bridge-certificate.crt` exported from the workspace on the phone, or specify a trusted certificate via `IEXA_TLS_CERT` / `IEXA_TLS_KEY`.
- Each project can have multiple independent conversations. Conversations are persistently bound to the project working directory and can be pinned within the project. Background concurrent tasks will not change the tool working directory when switching projects.

chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.description: Daily 竞彩 (JingCai) football match analysis and reading of football betting odds; sports lottery
chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.body:
# ⚽ Football Signal Radar · Daily Signal Report

> **Set emotion aside and watch only the signals.**
> Cross-validation across three channels of odds movement. No bets at low odds; no bets when the signal is unclear. Bets are placed automatically before kickoff and settled automatically after the match.

## 🚀 Online Site

- **[https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/](https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/)**
- Updated automatically every hour, historical dates archived, available to review anytime
- Covers **500–1300+** matches per day (full 竞彩 / Asian handicap coverage), automatically flagging signals and bets

---

## The Detours We Skipped

We tried **models**: piled on parameters until the room was full. Looking back, the model just repeated prices the market had already set. No matter how many parameters we added, it could not produce anything new.

We tried **studying the bookmakers' moves**: guessing at the house's tactics, and the more we guessed, the more it looked like paranoia. In the end it became clear that guessing at the bookmaker is worth less than simply watching the price.

We also tried **AI predictions**: injuries, motivation, form. Each one sounded convincing, and each had already been priced into the odds. However loud they were, the market did not buy it.

With the detours behind us, one plain truth remains:

> **Where the money goes, the odds speak.**
> But people watching the odds get carried away easily: chasing favorites, fearing upsets, trembling near kickoff. You can tell at a glance when emotion is doing the trading.

So we hand both "watching" and "buying" to the machine, and the human keeps only one thing: **discipline**.

## Three Informants, One Referee

**European odds** track market-wide odds movement: who has been collectively abandoned, who is quietly defending, and whether the draw line has been given up. This is the informant closest to the action.

**Asian handicap** tracks the line and water levels: sudden pivots near kickoff, and upper-side money sniping. Money put down in real cash is more honest than anything said out loud.

**Over/Under** tracks the total goals line. Once a goal-scoring hotbed appears, the goal count for that match has often already been decided.

Each of the three informants has its own news. When the news lines up, the referee dares to make the call. **Matches where the signals disagree (European odds and Asian handicap fighting each other) are left alone entirely.** If the informants are already arguing, why would you bet at all?

## Discipline Matters More Than Vision

Once the direction is set, everything else is discipline:

- **No bets at low odds**: single-selection odds below 1.5, or double-selection odds that discount below 1.3, will not be bought even with a strong signal. At odds that low, winning does not even make money.
- **No bets on unclear signals**: no signal, conflicting signals, or an ambiguous direction means waiting. Missing a bet costs no money; betting wrong does.
- **Quality determines stake size**: the firmer the signal, the larger the stake (1/2/4 units). No going all-in.
- **Auto-bet 15 minutes before kickoff, auto-settle when results come in**: no pre-match jitters, no urge to add stakes after a win or chase losses after a defeat.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is for data research only and does not constitute any betting advice. Lottery tickets should be purchased at licensed physical retail outlets. Persons under 18 may not participate.

goodrain/rainskills.description: RainSkills is a set of open-source Agent Skills that enable Codex, Claude Code, Pi Agent, DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, and Hermes Agent to perform application recognition, deployment, troubleshooting, delivery verification, version management, and rollback.
goodrain/rainskills.body:
# RainSkills

> Let your AI Agent deploy the current project online and verify the page and API.

RainSkills is a set of open-source Agent Skills that enable Codex, Claude Code, Pi Agent, DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, and Hermes Agent to continue with application deployment, troubleshooting, delivery verification, version management, and rollback.

It starts from the current project that the Agent already understands, and organizes the frontend, backend, database, cache, ports, and storage into a Rainbond application. Applications can run on Rainbond Cloud, your own server, or Kubernetes.

**AI generates, RainSkills delivers, Rainbond keeps it running.**

[Product Introduction](https://www.rainbond.com/rainskills) ·
[Installation and Usage](https://www.rainbond.com/docs/ai/rainskills) ·
[Video Tutorial](https://www.rainbond.com/videos/rainskills-ai-deploy) ·
[Rainbond Cloud](https://run.rainbond.com) ·
[WeChat Discussion](#微信交流)

## Why Use RainSkills

AI Agents already understand the code, dependencies, and project structure. When it comes to the deployment stage, if you switch to temporary scripts or direct SSH, this context usually has to be reorganized, and the deployment results are hard to turn into an application that can be maintained over time.

| Comparison dimension | Agent direct SSH / temporary scripts | RainSkills + Rainbond |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Starting point | Reorganize servers, ports, dependencies, and commands | Directly reuse current project context |
| Application structure | Manually assemble processes, databases, networking, and storage | Manage components and dependencies with an application topology |
| Failure troubleshooting | Manually look for build, container, and gateway logs | Agent reads build logs, runtime logs, Pods, and platform events |
| Completion criteria | Command succeeded or process has started | Page and API have been verified by actual access |
| Permission boundary | Agent usually holds SSH or production credentials directly | Browser authorization, controlled tool calls, and confirmation for high-risk operations |
| Ongoing maintenance | Continue maintaining scripts and server differences | Upgrade, snapshot, release, and roll back on the same application |

RainSkills is better suited to multi-component applications, self-hosted environments, private delivery, and projects that need ongoing troubleshooting and version management.

## How RainSkills Works

```text
current project or deployment target
  → AI Agents such as Codex and Claude Code
  → RainSkills selects the corresponding deployment, troubleshooting, or verification Skill
  →…
```

xyzmean/ru-bypass-ipsets.body:
# ru-bypass-ipsets

Categorized IPv4 ipset lists for bypassing blocks (Russian Federation). Resolves domains to CIDR by category and publishes ready-made `.lst` files for routing traffic through VPN/proxy.

The main consumer is [splify](https://github.com/xyzmean/splify) (OpenWrt). The format is compatible with `clean_ip_list`: strictly `A.B.C.D/N`, no bare IPs.

## Principle

1. **Sources** — vendor snapshots in the repo + reliable online APIs (`antifilter.download`, RIPEstat, Cloudflare/AWS CDN). The only external repository used is the ready-made Discord ipset (`1andrevich/Re-filter-lists`), which has a snapshot in `sources/discord/`: an unavailable source does not empty the list, but rolls it back to the last successful download.
2. **Resolution** — `dnspython` across 6 nameservers (including Yandex 77.88.8.8), merging A records from all resolvers for maximum CDN coverage.
3. **ASN-pull** — for large services (Telegram, Meta, …) CIDRs are taken directly by ASN (RIPEstat → ip.guide → bgpview) and from CDN feeds (Cloudflare, CloudFront).
4. **Merging** — `collapse_addresses()` collapses overlaps and adjacent networks into the largest possible subnets; dedupe + sort.

yezijinn/Jinn_AndroidInputMethod.body:
# Sprite Input Method

Lightweight Android input method (IME): 26-key full pinyin / dual pinyin (7 schemes), clipboard history, categorized word libraries. All core features run locally with no server;
The APK is about 3.2MB and does not include offline voice data.

[English](https://github.com/yezijinn/Jinn_AndroidInputMethod/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) ｜ Chinese

> **Voice dictation is optional and does not work out of the box:** recognition runs on a server, so you need to deploy
> [CapsWriter Offline](https://github.com/HaujetZhao/CapsWriter-Offline) (Docker) yourself on a home NAS. The Android app uploads audio over WebSocket.
> Without a self-hosted server, it won't work. The pinyin keyboard, clipboard, and word libraries are unrelated to voice and do not need a server.

## Features

**Pinyin keyboard (26-key)**
- Full pinyin / dual pinyin / English; 7 dual-pinyin schemes (Natural Code, Xiaohe, Sogou, Microsoft, Ziguang, Smart ABC, Jiajia). Key faces automatically show finals and zh/ch/sh hints (the “Show finals on keys” option on the settings page can be turned off, after which key faces show only letters). Switch via “Pinyin input scheme” on the settings page; the selection takes effect globally as soon as it is chosen.
- Character set: 5,613 common characters are included by default (rare names and place-name characters such as 囧 / 淼 / 喆 / 昇 can be typed directly). “Add more rare characters” on the settings page lets you enable level-2 (837 characters) and level-3 (2,923 characters) rare characters by tier. Tier 3 requires tier 2 to be enabled first. Changes take effect immediately when checked.
- “Use traditional characters only” (settings page): candidates are replaced with traditional forms using a simplified-to-traditional mapping table before committing (e.g., 爱 → 愛, 碍 → 礙). The toggle takes effect immediately. Learning records are still saved in simplified form, so simplified and traditional modes share them.
- Incomplete pinyin completion (`ni m` / `nim` → 「你们」), and word-library constrained segmentation (`xuni` → `xu+ni` virtual).
- Candidate bar: the pinyin strip is laid out horizontally and shows the pressed letters. For dual pinyin, the “Full-syllable candidates for dual pinyin” option on the settings page can expand them into full initial-plus-final pinyin (e.g., `vsgo` → `zhongguo`). Candidates appear below the strip. The bar can be single-row or double-row; in double-row mode, the pinyin strip sits between the two candidate rows. The candidate bar can also append extra candidate words (off by default). Switching between Chinese and English takes one tap.
- Corner radius, gap, key height, candidate font size, candidate spacing, and opacity are adjusted under “Keyboard appearance” on the settings page (0–48dp / 0–16dp / 40–90dp / 14–42sp / 5–55dp / 0–100%). Changes apply live while dragging. When the candidate font size changes, the whole candidate bar grows or shrinks accordingly.
- Keyboard skins: 32 sets (original black / original white plus 30 color schemes), 16 light and 16 dark. They are drawn entirely in code with zero bitmaps, and are independent of the three items above.
- UI light/dark switching: follow system / light / dark / scheduled. Light and dark **each select one skin**, and the keyboard skin switches along with the mode.
- Fuzzy-pinyin tolerance (off by default): 11 groups of accent-equivalent sounds (zh⇄z, n⇄l, en⇄eng, etc.) can be checked as needed. When nothing matches, other readings of that sound are added. Exact candidates are left untouched and not replaced.

| **Usable when the server is unreachable** | In offline mode, "History" comes from the local log cache plus `.svn/wc.db` revision metadata. Read-only mode disables writes with one click (enforced twice, including on the server side) |
| **Automatic tidy-up before commit** | Unversioned `?` items are automatically `svn add`ed and missing `!` items are automatically `svn delete`d. Results are reported honestly, including failures. Each action has its own toggle |

zhoujianbin/pi-agent-guide.body:
# PI agent 学习指南

A fresh-styled personal learning site based on a source-code breakdown of the open-source project **[Pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi)** (a production-grade AI Agent runtime foundation). It organizes core mechanisms such as the Agent Loop, tool pipeline, message system, event-driven design, context engineering, compression algorithms, and session trees into a ten-chapter, readable and verifiable guide written in Chinese.

## 🔗 在线阅读

**https://pistudy.com.cn**

The fully deployed site, with all pages pre-rendered as static HTML. Open and read; mobile-friendly.

## 📸 站点预览

## 功能亮点

- **Ten-chapter guide**: from the three-layer architecture to the Agent Loop, model calls, tool system, message system, event-driven design, context engineering, compression algorithms, and session management, broken down layer by layer
- **3 interview Q&A bubbles per chapter**: a "read with questions" opener at the start of each chapter, and floating "面试题 N" Q&A bubbles beside the matching paragraphs in the body, so you can self-test as you read
- **30-question interview collection page** (`/questions/`): Q&A from all ten chapters summarized on one quick-reference page, with links to expanded reading
- **Hands-on column** (`/lab/`): build a mini Agent yourself. It uses zero-dependency pure Node.js and has 6 stages, from raw fetch to a tool loop, streaming events, context compression, an interactive REPL, and session forking. Each stage is checked against the Pi source. The companion code is open source at [pi-mini-agent](https://github.com/zhoujianbin/pi-mini-agent), and all 6 stages have passed tests against the real API
- **Command cheat sheet** (`/cheatsheet/`): slash commands, CLI arguments, editor tips, and default shortcuts on one page, with in-page filtering
- **Ecosystem picks** (`/ecosystem/`): curated by category from 5,300+ community packages in the official package registry, each with a one-line Chinese summary and a one-line install command
- **Site-wide search**: open it from the navbar search button or with `⌘K / Ctrl+K`. A local index covers chapter text, interview Q&A, the cheat sheet, ecosystem entries, and lab entries, with instant matching
- **28 architecture diagrams**: off-white SVG illustrations embedded at the matching positions in the chapter text
- **Fresh responsive design**: a mint-green × sky-blue light theme with a single-column adaptive layout on mobile
- **SEO-friendly**: 20 pages pre-rendered as static HTML at build time, each with its own title, description, and canonical URL. Interview Q&A generates FAQPage structured data, and the site ships with a sitemap and robots.txt

## 技术栈

- React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 7
- Tailwind CSS 3 + shadcn/ui components
- markdown-it (chapter Markdown rendering) + a hand-written lightweight YAML frontmatter parser
- react-router (chapter routing, with browser back/forward support)
